papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.contribution: Introduced the Transformer architecture based entirely on self-attention mechanisms, replacing recurrent networks.
papers.methodology: Multi-Head Self-Attention layers combined with Positional Encodings for parallel sequence processing.
papers.limitation: Quadratic computational scaling O(N^2) with sequence length and lack of persistent external memory.
papers.future_scope: Exploration of sparse attention patterns, long-context window architectures, and external memory coupling.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.contribution: Demonstrated deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text using masked language modeling.
papers.methodology: Masked Language Modeling (MLM) and Next Sentence Prediction (NSP) pre-training on Wikipedia and BookCorpus.
papers.limitation: Static parametric memory cannot incorporate post-training knowledge without costly retraining.
papers.future_scope: Dynamic parametric updating, fine-grained knowledge retrieval, and parameter-efficient tuning.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.contribution: Pioneered RAG architectures combining parametric seq2seq models with non-parametric dense vector retrieval.
papers.methodology: Dense Passage Retriever (DPR) combined with BART generator trained end-to-end via marginalizing retrieved documents.
papers.limitation: High retrieval latency, fixed chunk granularity, and sensitivity to noise in retrieved passages.
papers.future_scope: Iterative multi-step retrieval, query rewrite mechanisms, and active self-reflective retrieval.

papers.title: REPLUG: Retrieval-Augmented Black-Box Language Models
papers.contribution: Enabled retrieval augmentation for proprietary black-box language models without modifying weights.
papers.methodology: Ensemble perplexity scoring over prepended passage contexts with retriever supervision via LM feedback.
papers.limitation: Context window saturation when incorporating multiple retrieved documents simultaneously.
papers.future_scope: Hierarchical document compression, cross-document attention synthesis, and rank-aware prompting.

papers.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
papers.contribution: Introduced dynamic self-reflective tokens for adaptive retrieval, critique, and hallucination suppression.
papers.methodology: Specialized reflection tokens ([Retrieve], [IsRel], [IsSup], [IsUse]) learned via supervised instruction fine-tuning.
papers.limitation: Increased inference time due to multi-step reflection token generation and evaluation branches.
papers.future_scope: Speculative reflection decoding, lightweight token classification heads, and streaming verification.

papers.title: GraphRAG: Unlocking LLM Discovery Over Enterprise Text Graphs
papers.contribution: Combined Knowledge Graph extraction with community summary retrieval for global dataset query understanding.
papers.methodology: LLM-driven entity-relationship extraction, Leiden community detection, and hierarchical graph summarization.
papers.limitation: Heavy computational overhead during offline index construction and graph partitioning.
papers.future_scope: Incremental real-time graph updates, hybrid dense-sparse graph neural indexing, and continuous graph reasoning.

papers.title: Agentic Dynamic Memory & Long-Horizon Research Lineage
papers.contribution: Formulated autonomous memory trees that synthesize multi-paper lineage tracking and hypothesis generation.
papers.methodology: Graph-based memory state vectors with real-time vector compaction and symbolic belief revision network.
papers.limitation: State decay during long multi-hop reasoning loops across contradictory multi-domain sources.
papers.future_scope: Quantum-inspired vector spaces, neural symbolic belief propagation, and persistent agent state sync.

major_breakthroughs: Transition from static parametric models (BERT/GPT-2) to dynamically augmented retrieval architectures (RAG, REPLUG).
Integration of self-reflective critique tokens allowing LLMs to autonomously determine when and what to retrieve.
Evolution from raw unstructured passage search to structured GraphRAG community summaries and entity networks.
Emergence of agentic memory trees capable of tracking long-horizon research lineage and gap discovery.
summary.methodology_evolution: The domain evolved from early dense vector retrieval over static text chunks (2020) towards adaptive black-box LM prompting (2022), self-criticism tokens (2023), entity knowledge graph summarization (2024), and dynamic symbolic agent memory networks (2025-2026).
summary.current_state: Current research is focused on unified Graph-Dense hybrid indexing, real-time agent memory compaction, continuous zero-shot index updating, and autonomous hypothesis generation over evolving multi-modal paper databases.

gaps.title: High Retrieval Noise & Context Contamination
gaps.description: Dense retriever top-k passages frequently inject irrelevant or contradictory facts that pollute downstream reasoning.

gaps.title: Expensive Graph Indexing Overhead
gaps.description: Extracting community summaries and hierarchical graph nodes requires prohibitive upfront LLM calls.

gaps.title: Lack of Multi-Hop Temporal Reasoning
gaps.description: Existing RAG pipelines struggle to track how definitions and assumptions change across publication years.

gaps.title: Fine-Grained Citation Grounding
gaps.description: Generated responses often cite an entire paper without pinpointing exact equations, figures, or table rows.

gaps.title: Static Index Stale Knowledge Decay
gaps.description: Vector database indices become obsolete when newer papers disprove prior assumptions.

most_influential_paper.title: Attention Is All You Need
most_influential_paper.reason: Laid the fundamental architecture upon which all modern transformer-based language and retrieval models operate.

biggest_methodology_shift.title: From Unstructured Passage Chunks to Graph Knowledge Summaries
biggest_methodology_shift.from_method: Fixed-character text chunking & single cosine similarity vector search
biggest_methodology_shift.to_method: LLM entity extraction + Leiden community summarization (GraphRAG)
biggest_methodology_shift.impact: Unlocks global dataset-level synthesis rather than localized facts.

emerging_trend.trend: Self-Reflective Agentic Memory & Continuous Lineage Discovery
emerging_trend.description: Autonomous agents utilizing dynamic self-criticism tokens and graph memory trees to synthesize research directions.
